title: Obtain a Michigan electrical contractor license
authority: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs, Bureau of Construction Codes
description: A business doing electrical work in Michigan must obtain an electrical contractor license. The contractor must hold a Michigan master electrician license or employ a full-time Michigan-resident master electrician designated as the master electrician of record; an application is required even though no electrical-contractor examination is required.
renewal: Renew every three years by December 31; the qualifying master electrician must remain associated or the contractor license is placed on hold.

title: Obtain a Michigan plumbing contractor license
authority: Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs, Bureau of Construction Codes
description: A business doing plumbing work in Michigan must obtain a plumbing contractor license. The applicant must hold a master plumber license or employ a licensed master plumber as the representative of record, and must pass the required examination and pay the license fee.
renewal: Renew every three years by April 30; the current renewal guidance lists a $300 renewal fee and a $100 late fee.
